name: boundary_rim
doc: Resolves a boundary's hull (design/boundary.md) into its rim: the hull's cells (or the hex ring of its radius) with gaps filled by hex lines, turned counterclockwise as seen from above, auto edges taken from their direction's sector; then the smoothed line through their centres sampled every metre, each sample with its height, outward direction, rise, and share of each edge blended along the rim, so edges taper into each other.
